'''Kalyn Farnmir''' was a [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Kuati Security Forces]] who was framed by corrupt members of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] and dishonorably discharged as a result. She then became a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], partnering up with the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Cian Shee/Legends|Cian Shee]] and finding a regular place at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Coruscant. The two took down the [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] of the [[Zealots of Psusan/Legends|Zealots of Psusan]], [[Scri Oscuro]], who planned revenge on Farnmir from [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. He was able to lure Shee to work with him though [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]].

When Farnmir learned of the plot in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], she was shaken and had to learn the truth for herself. She planned a meeting at the Outlander with Shee and arrived there first, interrogating cultist [[Nyrat Agira/Legends|Nyrat Agira]] about the dealing. Agira was able to confirm the deal, verifying the bounty hunter's worst fears. When Shee arrived, the two embraced at the club's bar and sat together. When the two left, Farnmir tried to capture Shee, but she escaped and called off the deal with Oscuro. In the later [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Farnmir aided the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] while her former partner took up contracts for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. When the slicer took in a contract to bring Farnmir in, they fought on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], ending when Farnmir [[Death/Legends|killed]] Shee. 

==Biography==
===Dealing justice===
[[File:Eaw Kuat.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Kalyn Farnmir's homeworld was the planet Kuat (pictured).]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] with no roots, Kalyn Farnmir was a [[Kuati/Legends|native]] [[Homeworld/Legends|of]]<ref name="DB" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CATCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] and a member of the [[Kuati Security Forces|planet's security force]]. She was the victim of a set up done by corrupt members of the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] corporation where in which she took the fall for their dealings of corporate secrets to [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] agents. Farnmir was dishonorably discharged but continued to bring the lawless to justice through becoming a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].<ref name="DB" /> 

With a new partner, the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Cian Shee/Legends|Cian Shee]], Farnmir enjoyed some level of success finding small-time criminals and corporate thieves.<ref name="DB" /> Due to its quantity of criminals that may have proved profitable,<ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> the bounty hunter had a regular place at the bar of the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|96|OUT 1-2|Outlander Nightclub Patrons}}</ref> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of<ref name="FF" /> the Core World<ref name="CATCW" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="FF" /> 

===Cult revenge===
By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="DBdate">The events in Kalyn Farnmir's [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry show the apprehension of [[Scri Oscuro]] by Farnmir and [[Cian Shee/Legends|Cian Shee]] happen before the events of {{Film|II}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Farnmir,<ref name="DB" /> with the help of the hired Cian Shee,<ref name="db shee">{{DB|character|cianshee|Shee, Cian}}</ref> brought down the [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] of the religious cult [[Zealots of Psusan/Legends|Zealots of Psusan]], [[Scri Oscuro]],<ref name="DB" /> after former members of the cult discovered his use of spiritual influence for illegal ventures. Oscuro, however, planned revenge from [[Prison/Legends|prison]] using his cult contacts. He lured Shee to work with him through<ref name="CSWEScri">{{CSWECite|II|426|Oscuro, Scri}}</ref> a hefty payout<ref name="DB" /> of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="CSWEScri" /> One [[Local day/Legends|night]] on Coruscant<ref name="DB" /> in 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The events in Kalyn Farnmir's [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry show Agira's interrogation happening shortly before Farnmir meeting [[Cian Shee/Legends|Cian Shee]], which is shown in the film. Therefore, the events in the Databank entry must take place in 22 BBY.</ref> Farnmir was alerted of the plot and her partner's involvement by an informant. The bounty hunter was shaken by the information and sought to learn the truth. She planned a discussion over work at the Outlander Club with Shee, knowing the Zealots were experiencing popularity in Coruscant's trendier districts.<ref name="DB" />

Farnmir arrived at the Outlander first and scoped out the club, noticing several signs of the cult.<ref name="DB" /> After recognizing her Psusan [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]], the bounty hunter came face-to-face with the cultist [[Nyrat Agira/Legends|Nyrat Agira]],<ref name="db">{{DB|character|nyratagira|Agira, Nyrat}}</ref> whom she easily intimidated and interrogated<ref name="DB" /> about her cult tattoo and Oscuro's whereabouts.<ref name="CSWEAgira">{{CSWECite|I|14|Agira, Nyrat}}</ref> The woman revealed that the High Priest, who was on Coruscant, did do dealings with Shee,<ref name="DB" /> confirming Farnmir's worst fears.<ref name="db" /> The bounty hunter then knew what had to be done.<ref name="DB" />  

[[File:SineadOConnorInSpace-AotC.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Farnmir embraced Cian Shee at the Outlander Club to allay suspicion.]]
Farnmir sat at the bar of the club when the bounty hunter [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] ran into the club, trying the escape from two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] after her [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="aotc" /> When Shee arrived, the bounty hunter pretended nothing was wrong and acted friendly to not appear suspicious.<ref name="DB" /> She embraced her partner at the bar and was served a drink by<ref name="aotc" /> chief [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] [[Bufon Taire/Legends|Bufon Taire]].<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref> The bounty hunter then<ref name="aotc" /> leaned up against the bar<ref name="Who's Who" /> and stared at her drink. Farnmir and Shee stayed sat at the bar just moments before one of the Jedi, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], disarmed Wesell with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] at the bar.<ref name="aotc" /> Seeing Kenobi give his own brand of justice only steeled her resolve. When the partners left the club, Farnmir tried to pin down Shee, but her reflexes allowed her to flee and call off the deal with Oscuro, knowing that her former partner was expecting an ambush.<ref name="DB" />

[[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Farnmir aided the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], as she despised the Empire. Shee, who took Imperial contracts, got one to bring Farnmir in.<ref name="DB" /> At some point by [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="TFU">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'', which includes the [[Corellian Treaty|formation]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], to [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. Therefore, Cian Shee's death on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in Kalyn Farnmir's [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry must happen during or after 2 BBY.</ref> the two faced each other in single combat on the<ref name="DB" /> [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="Shaddaa">{{DB|location|narshaddaa|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Farnmir made no mistakes and made Shee pay for her betrayal with her [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="DB" />

==Personality and traits==
Loyalty meant everything to Farnmir. When the<ref name="DB" /> no-nonsense<ref name="Fans">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20080321.html|text=What's the Story: The Fans Set the Facts}}</ref> woman learned her partner betrayed her, she was shaken and had to learn the truth.<ref name="DB" /> The tough<ref name="ToughCustomer">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2002/11/imageattack20021121.html|series=Image Attack|text=Tough Customer}}</ref> and formidable<ref name="Who's Who" /> Farnmir was able to easily interrogate Nyrat Agira,<ref name="DB" /> and the questioning confirmed her worst fears over Shee's betrayal.<ref name="db" /> Farnmir despised the Galactic Empire, from which her traitorous former partner took contracts from.<ref name="DB" /> The [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]]-looking<ref name="Who's Who" /> woman stood at 1.74 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and had [[Color/Legends|light]] skin, short blonde [[Hair/Legends|hair]],<ref name="DB" /> and gray [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="aotc" />

==Skills and abilities==
Farnmir used her skills in her bounty hunting. When they confronted each other on Nar Shaddaa, the bounty hunter made no mistakes fighting Cian Shee.<ref name="DB" />

==Equipment==
Farnmir used a shiny silver [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="Who's Who" /> During the night she visited the Outlander Club<ref name="aotc" /> in 22 BBY,<ref name="NEC" /> she wore black body [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="Who's Who" /> She had few possessions.<ref name="DB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We don't know whether to attribute it to the armor or the shaved head, but she looks like she could break Obi-Wan in half.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Who's Who" />}}
[[File:KalynFarnmir3.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Kalyn Farnmir was portrayed by Jack Laurian Pascoe.]]
Kalyn Farnmir first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="aotc" /> which released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> The Outlander Club scenes, where the Farnmir was portrayed by an uncredited<ref name="aotc" /> [[Jack Laurian Pascoe]],<ref name="Actress">{{Twitter|username=ThatPascoeWoman|url=status/1761906903846985753|name=[[Jack Laurian Pascoe]]|date=2024-02-26|quote="That is indeed me! 😊"|nobackup=1}} {{C|In response to: @ThatPascoeWoman if you can, can you confirm whether or not you were this uncredited extra in Attack of the Clones? I'm trying to ID this extra.}}</ref> were shot on [[July 17]], [[2000]], at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]].<ref name="365Days">''[[Creating the Worlds of Star Wars: 365 Days]]''</ref> Farnmir was first revealed<ref name="WebDoc">{{SW|url=/video/good-to-g-o|series=Making Episode II Webdocs|text=Part 10: Good to G.O.}}</ref> on [[February 26]], 2002,<ref name="Archive">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/me2/archive.html|text=''Making Episode II Webdocs'' archive}}</ref> with the release of the web documentary "Good to G.O."<ref name="WebDoc" /> The character was first named through the Episode II [[Depth Commentary]] available on [[StarWars.com]], accessible through the DVD-ROM home release of Attack of the Clones<ref name="DepthCommentary">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=Depth Commentary}}</ref> on [[November 12]], 2002.<ref name="DVD">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/news/2002/08/news20020801.html|text=Episode II On DVD & VHS}}</ref> Farnmir's name was created by [[Lucasfilm]]'s [[Pablo Hidalgo]], who used a [[tuckerization]] of the name of [[Mary Franklin]],<ref name="Who's Who" /> a fan-events coordinator at Lucasfilm.<ref name="Franklin">{{InsiderCite|75|Star News}}</ref> 

In the [[April 6]], [[2004]],<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040315.html|text=The New Face of Evil}}</ref> article "[[Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night]]," published in the [[Star Wars Insider 75|seventy-fifth]] issue of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'', author [[Daniel Wallace]] wrote that Farnmir looked like she could break Obi-Wan Kenobi in half.<ref name="Who's Who" /> Through the StarWars.com "[[What's The Story?|What's the Story?]]" feature, [[Captain Yossarian|Benjamin Christopher Norton Dawe]], writing under the alias "Captain Yossarian," wrote the character's entry in the StarWars.com [[Databank (original)|Databank]].<ref name="DB" /> Farnmir's entry was posted alongside the second round of entries done through the feature on [[September 30]], [[2005]].<ref name="DBrwdate">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20050930.html|text=Hyperspace Presents: What's The Story, Round 2}}</ref>
